name: Persona 3: Dancing in Moonlight - Chibi Investigation Team Set
summary: A set of 9 chibi-character accessories (P4 Protagonist, Yosuke, Chie, Yukiko, Rise, Kanji, Naoto, Teddie, and Nanako) for all characters. This item is compatible with both Persona 3: Dancing in Moonlight and Persona 5: Dancing in Starlight on PS4.
